components.name: ffmpeg
components.rationale: Reconciled all currently open/undetermined Debian FFmpeg entries against the pinned source and actual restricted build. Older resolved upstream entries are covered by 9.0.2; applicable MEDIUM advisories remain reported, not exempted. This is not a zero-vulnerability statement.

advisories.rationale: The native h264 decoder and h264 parser are excluded from this audio-only build. The vulnerable H264 decoder helper is not available; MPEG-TS is also not an enabled demuxer. Actual image-profile tests enforce component absence.
The dvdsub parser is excluded from the build. Subtitle decoding is not part of the PCM audio output contract; the actual image parser inventory is checked.
Network protocols and external libssh are disabled; only pipe/cache protocols are enabled.
The DASH demuxer and network protocols are not compiled into this decoder.
RTSP demuxing/network protocols are excluded. The API also allows only the fixed local-container demuxer whitelist.
Conservatively retained for the linked libavutil component. The service emits only mono PCM16 audio and does not serialize HDR video metadata; no claim of an upstream fix is made.

MOV remains supported. The PSSH recursive-free/quadratic-work issue is not claimed fixed: retain the advisory. Upload, decoder-slot, duration/output and wall-clock limits plus process-group kill/reaping bound this isolated decoder failure. The referenced upstream patch is still pending and is not backported speculatively.

components.name: whisper.cpp
components.rationale: Checked OpenWhispr and ggml-org public advisory feeds plus the separately published model-loader CVE. Empty repository feeds alone are not treated as proof of no vulnerabilities. Retained model-loader MEDIUM finding remains visible.

advisories.rationale: Conservatively retain the linked model-loader assertion finding. Models are fixed operator-selected checksum-verified assets, not request uploads. Invalid model bytes are rejected during staging where possible; no native fork/fix is claimed.

components.name: cuda
components.rationale: Reconciled the current CUDA Toolkit bulletin against the shipped Linux runtime component inventory. Host GPU-driver/kernel security is an operator prerequisite and is outside this container-component conclusion.

advisories.rationale: NVIDIA bulletin5755 concerns Nsight tooling/scripts or Windows installer behavior. The Linux runtime ships CUDA runtime/cuBLAS/cuFFT libraries, not Nsight tools or installers. Runtime dpkg inventory and absence-of-tools image checks are required; builder tooling is not copied into the final image.
